summary.one_liner: Pythonx embeds a CPython interpreter inside the BEAM process so Elixir code can evaluate Python and convert data between the two languages.
summary.what_it_does: Runs a Python interpreter in the same OS process as an Elixir application via Erlang NIFs. Pythonx.eval/2 evaluates Python code with Elixir-provided globals and returns results as Pythonx.Object values, which Pythonx.decode/1 converts into Elixir data. Pythonx.uv_init/1 sets the Python version and dependencies, using the uv package manager. A ~PY sigil works in IEx and Livebook, and an application config option sets up the interpreter at compile time and boot. A Python module named pythonx provides send_tagged_object/3 to send Python objects to an Elixir process as messages.
use_cases: Call Python libraries such as numpy from Elixir code
Run Python snippets inside Livebook notebooks
Pass data between Elixir and Python without serialization over ports
Stream results from a long-running Python computation back to an Elixir process
Ship an Elixir release that includes a bundled Python environment
how_to_run: Add {:pythonx, "~> 0.4.0"} to your dependencies (or use Mix.install in a script)
Call Pythonx.uv_init/1 with a pyproject.toml string specifying requires-python and dependencies
Call Pythonx.eval/2 with Python code and a map of Elixir variables
Use Pythonx.decode/1 on the result to convert it back to Elixir
For applications, set config :pythonx, :uv_init, pyproject_toml: ... in config/config.exs instead
notable: Embeds CPython in the same OS process as the BEAM rather than spawning a separate python executable
Python version and dependencies declared in a pyproject.toml-style string, managed by uv
~PY sigil for evaluating Python interactively in IEx and Livebook
Send messages from Python to Elixir processes with pythonx.send_tagged_object
Priv-directory layout intended to be compatible with Elixir releases
caveats: The Python GIL means concurrent calls from multiple Elixir processes give little speedup; the README recommends a single process or System.cmd/Ports
The ~PY sigil does not work inside Mix project code by design
Downloads happen at compile time when configured as an application
keywords: send messages from python to elixir
